backend/main.mo: Minimal backend canister with an empty actor.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of key frontend files and hooks.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining prerequisites and steps for building and deploying the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with custom OKLCH color variables and dark mode settings.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry page loading the React frontend via main.tsx.
frontend/scripts/validate-icp0-subdomain: CLI script that validates icp0.io subdomains and prints guidance or errors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main Valentine interaction page with Yes/No buttons and success state showing a meme.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook that moves the No button to random screen positions on pointer or touch events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing login, stored identities, and auth client setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and defines extensive OKLCH-based theme variables for light/dark modes plus basic animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and an Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Contains project metadata, feature requirements, and deployment notes for the Valentine-themed interactive site.
